headlines.title: NFLX Stock Heads For 4-Day Slide, Extends September Losing Streak After Wells Fargo Flags “Worrying” Engagement In Downgrade
headlines.summary: Wells Fargo downgraded Netflix to 'Underweight' from 'Equal Weight' and cut its price target to $57 from $80.

headlines.title: Evercore wants investors to buy tumbling streaming stock
headlines.summary: The Wall Street firm sees a rare entry point in one streaming stock’s roughest stretch in years.

headlines.title: Netflix vs. Disney: Which Streaming Stock Has an Edge Right Now?
headlines.summary: DIS' diversified growth, streaming profitability and rich content slate give it an edge over NFLX as investors weigh valuations.

headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Joins A New Streaming Policy Coalition
headlines.summary: Netflix (NasdaqGS:NFLX), Amazon and YouTube have formed the Streaming Access and Choice Alliance to lobby on streaming policy and sports rights. The coalition plans to push for technology neutral rules that cover both traditional broadcasters and online platforms in live sports distribution. Founding members intend to present a unified position to governments that are reviewing how sports rights are licensed and regulated on streaming services.

headlines.title: The Next $100 Billion of Netflix’s Value Could Come From Here, 98% Upside Ahead
headlines.summary: Netflix shares have shed more than a third of their value over the past year, yet the company's ad business is exploding and buybacks are hitting record pace. Our proprietary model sees a stark disconnect between where the stock trades today and where the fundamentals say it should go.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
